# Boundary files

Simplified ABS boundaries, converted from the `nswgeo` R package (https://github.com/cidm-ph/nswgeo) to GeoJSON.

| File | Contents | Simplification |
|---|---|---|
| `nsw_state.geojson` | NSW state outline (includes ACT and Jervis Bay; excludes Lord Howe Island) | ABS ASGS Ed. 3 |
| `greater_sydney.geojson` | Greater Sydney (GCCSA) outline | 500 m tolerance |
| `nsw_lga_2024.geojson` | 129 NSW Local Government Areas, 2024 (excludes "No usual address" and "Migratory") | 750 m tolerance |

Source: Australian Bureau of Statistics, *Australian Statistical Geography Standard (ASGS) Edition 3*,
